plan.title: release: auto-hatch branch coverage hairline in Step 5 when ledger allows

narratives.Description: Release Step 5 almost always hits a Vitest branch-coverage hairline that already has deterministic hatch rules under #2866, but today the operator must fail, file debt, and re-run a 20-30m suite. This story classifies BRANCH_HAIRLINE after one run, auto-files the debt issue when the open ledger is empty, and continues the cut without re-running vitest.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Release Step 5 almost always hits the Vitest **branch** coverage hairline hatch (#2866 / `--allow-coverage-debt=#N`). Today that means: fail Step 5 → operator files a debt issue → re-run the full ~20–30m check/coverage gauntlet with the flag. The second lap is mostly ceremony tax; the hatch eligibility rules are already deterministic.

**Proposal:** after **one** Step 5 run, if the failure is hatch-eligible and the open-issue ledger allows a soft-pass, **auto-file** the coverage-debt issue and **continue the cut** without re-running Step 5.

## Motivation

- Observed pattern: consecutive cuts (including v0.97.0 / #3185) need the hatch.
- Fail-then-retry doubles wall-clock without adding safety when the classifier would accept the same hatch on re-run.
- #2866 already defines machine-checkable conditions (branch-only hairline; no open prior debt; markers; restore all four metrics).

## Proposed behavior

Inside `task release` Step 5, after vitest/check returns non-zero:

1. **Classify** the failure:
   - `REAL_FAILURE` — failed tests, hangs, non-coverage defects
   - `BRANCH_HAIRLINE` — branches sole metric < 85%; lines, functions, statements all ≥ 85%; zero failed tests
   - `OTHER_COVERAGE` — any other metric also under bar
   - `UNKNOWN` — cannot parse / ambiguous

2. `REAL_FAILURE` | `OTHER_COVERAGE` | `UNKNOWN` → **fail closed** (unchanged; still #2859 file-and-merge when product defect).

3. `BRANCH_HAIRLINE`:
   - Query open coverage-debt ledger (same probes as release skill #2866: title/body markers + CHANGELOG citation scan of open issues).
   - If **any open** coverage-debt / `--allow-coverage-debt` issue exists → **fail closed** ("restore coverage; close #N first") — preserves consecutive soft-pass ban.
   - Else → **create** issue `#N` with markers `coverage-debt` and `--allow-coverage-debt`, measured metrics, cut version, acceptance (all four metrics ≥ 85%); mark Step 5 `PASS_WITH_DEBT(#N)`; **continue** pipeline (no re-run); loud log + CHANGELOG/release citation of `#N`.

4. **File before continue** — never "would hatch" without a durable issue (avoids publish with no ledger).

## Non-goals

- Auto soft-pass for multi-metric coverage misses, hangs, or real test failures.
- Auto `--skip-ci` / general Step 5 skip.
- Lowering the 85% bar or excluding modules by default.
- Silent soft-pass with no issue / no markers.

## Optional knobs (later)

- `--no-auto-coverage-debt` — force fail-closed even on hairlines (hard cut).
- Sticky debt issue: amend open body instead of a new issue every cut.
- Streak limit: N auto-hatches without close → fail until restored (open-ledger alone already blocks if issue stays open).

## Acceptance

- [ ] One Step 5 invocation on branch-only hairline with empty debt ledger auto-files `#N` and continues release without re-running vitest.
- [ ] Open prior coverage-debt issue still fails closed (no consecutive soft-pass).
- [ ] Non-hairline failures still fail closed with no auto-issue.
- [ ] Classifier refuses when metrics/report cannot be parsed (UNKNOWN → fail closed).
- [ ] Operator-facing release skill / RELEASING.md disclose auto-hatch under Phase 1/Step 5.
- [ ] Unit tests for classify + ledger gate + issue create seams (no live network in unit tests).

## References

- Release skill `deft-directive-release` § Step 5 branch-coverage threshold — open-issue ledger hatch (#2866)
- Fixable check failure file-and-merge (#2859) — stays for real defects
- Recent hatch: #3185 (v0.97.0 84.95% branches)
- Prior restores: #3144, #3103, #3027, …

## Discussed in

Operator session: release v0.97.0; design discussion "run once, auto-hatch if legal, continue."

---

## Issue comment thread

_The issue body is the original write-up; maintainer comments below may supersede it. Read the full thread before building a dispatch envelope (#2143)._

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-08-07T15:21:26Z)

## Amendment (coordination with #3189 / #3188)

**Scope stays framework-release-first:** auto-hatch in `task release` Step 5 for deftai/directive remains valid without waiting on #3189.

**Consumer expansion** of the same auto-hatch *behavior* is **blocked on #3189** (project `coverageDebt` policy + session nudge). Do not auto-file debt on deftai/directive from consumer trees; consumer ledger is always the consumer repo.

**Depends-on / related:**
- #3188 — suite stamp + fast-before-slow (complements: one suite + no late full re-run)
- #3189 — PD policy + nudge (required before shipping hatch to consumers)
- #2866 — ledger rules unchanged
- #3185 — example open debt from v0.97.0 cut

**Acceptance add:** document that consumer-facing auto-hatch (if ever) must read `plan.policy.coverageDebt` and refuse when `status=unset` or `mode=off`.
narratives.UserStory: As a framework release operator, I want Step 5 to auto-hatch a branch-only hairline after one suite when the debt ledger is empty, so that I do not pay a full re-run tax for ceremony that is already deterministic.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add pure classifier module under packages/core/src/release/ (or vitest-runner/coverage-debt.ts) for REAL_FAILURE | BRANCH_HAIRLINE | OTHER_COVERAGE | UNKNOWN from Step 5 output. 2. Wire packages/core/src/release/pipeline.ts Step 5: BRANCH_HAIRLINE + empty open debt ledger -> create issue with coverage-debt markers, PASS_WITH_DEBT(#N), continue without re-run; open debt fails closed. 3. Also in pipeline: after suite green or PASS_WITH_DEBT write SHA suite stamp; re-entry same clean HEAD skips suite (coordinates with #3188 check ordering). 4. Unit tests in packages/core/src/release/*.test.ts and vitest-runner/coverage-debt.test.ts (no network). 5. content/skills/deft-directive-release/SKILL.md + docs/RELEASING.md. Verify: npm test -w @deftai/directive-core -- --run release/ and vitest-runner/coverage-debt.

narrative.Acceptance: Given branch-only hairline and empty debt ledger, when Step 5 runs once, then it auto-files #N and continues without re-running vitest.
Given an open coverage-debt issue, when Step 5 sees BRANCH_HAIRLINE, then it fails closed with no auto-issue and no consecutive soft-pass.
Given REAL_FAILURE, OTHER_COVERAGE, or UNKNOWN, when Step 5 classifies, then it fails closed with no auto-issue.
Given the PR, when release skill/RELEASING and unit tests are reviewed, then auto-hatch is disclosed and tests cover classify + ledger + create seams without live network.

items.title: SHA suite stamp on green or PASS_WITH_DEBT

narrative.Acceptance: Given suite green or PASS_WITH_DEBT at HEAD S, when a suite stamp is written and re-entry occurs at clean S, then suite is skipped; dirty tree or different HEAD invalidates stamp. CI never trusts stamp.
